title: Scholarships Plus
subtitle: Indigenous Education Technology
description:
Scholarships Plus helps Indigenous students organize opportunities, improve essays, and track applications across multiple academic years. Structured workflows keep deadlines, requirements, drafts, outcomes, and renewals in one place while preserving a longitudinal record of each student's growth.

The Remix and PostgreSQL application adds AI-assisted essay feedback, retrieval from a student's previous writing, a portal indexer for Native Forward, AISES, and Cobell, and a Chrome extension that places approved answers into real application forms. The long-term model strategy uses per-student writing to amplify each person's authentic voice rather than replace it.
